reasons: F01, F02, F03: material weakness in the financial close/reporting process with an adverse auditor ICFR opinion is a direct, significant control-failure signal raising the chance of misstatement.
R04, R02, R06, R15: declining sales, sharply declining gross margin, SG&A outpacing sales and falling ROA indicate operating pressure that creates incentives to manage results.
F21, F26: capital raise in year or planned plus emphasis on non-GAAP measures add motive to present results favourably.
F28, R05: a segment/reporting change and sharply slowing depreciation can obscure trends or flatter earnings (possible useful-life/estimate changes).
R13, F24: high soft-asset share with goodwill/intangibles as a critical audit matter means substantial judgement-heavy balances exposed to impairment timing risk under deteriorating performance.
R19: operating cash flow and net income of opposite signs warrants scrutiny of earnings quality.

Mitigating - R09, R17, R08, R01, R18, R03, R07: Beneish M-score and Dechow F-score below thresholds, negative accruals, normal DSO, receivables growing slower than sales, normal asset quality and stable leverage show no classic revenue-inflation pattern.

Mitigating - F04, F05, F06, F07, F14, F15, F16, F17, F18, F19, F10, F11: no going concern, auditor change, disagreements, prior-period correction, management turnover, investigations, litigation, covenant issues, channel-stuffing indicators or material related-party transactions.
